about_the_game:
Reng Azure Requiem Demo

In a world where souls have yet to find their final destination, you are resurrected in the frozen city of Soul's Passage. Your sole objective is to find the 7 keys to unleash the fearsome Tartariuno and return to Earth.

What you'll find in the demo:

  • Journey through three interconnected regions of Tartarius.

  • Face your first boss.

Test your combat and exploration abilities:

  • Teleportation Movement: Evade attacks and surprise your enemies.

  • Guardian Crow (Transformation): Transform into your guardian crow to see the atmospheric environment of Tartarius from a new perspective.

  • Guardian Crow (Summon): Summon your guardian crow to aid you in combat.

  • Guardian Shield: Summon a shield made from the souls of the righteous to protect yourself in combat.

"Please note: The demo was created to give you a taste of our gameplay, art, and atmosphere. It does not contain all the content, art, environments, enemies, or areas that will be available in the final version."

Enjoy the experience? Add Reng Azure Requiem to your wishlist so you don't miss the full game's launch!

short_description: Reng Azure Requiem is a dark pixel-art action RPG where you explore Tartarius in search of the 7 keys. Use teleportation, a shield of souls, and the aid of your guardian crow to master combat skills and face the fearsome Tartariuno.
